input.command: ls -la && echo "---PKG---" && cat package.json && echo "---VITEST---" && cat vitest.config.ts && echo "---TSCONFIG---" && cat tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null && echo "---SRC---" && ls -la src tests 2>/dev/null
for f in src/pricing.ts src/invoiceId.ts src/loyalty.ts src/cart.ts; do echo "=========== $f"; cat -n "$f"; done && echo "---TESTS---" && ls -la tests/
npx vitest run --coverage 2>&1 | grep -A12 "% Branch\|File.*Stmts\|-----" | head -20
